strategy: 4h Wilder RSI(20)>70 regime; 1h first entry; optional 0.75% pullback re-entry
source: Binance Vision public USD-M 1m klines, mark-price klines and funding archives; SHA256 verified

method.rsi: Wilder RSI(20) on completed UTC-aligned 4h candles; no 1h stride sampling
method.entry: Signal after completed 1h close; fill at next 1h open with adverse 2bp slippage
method.control: One initial entry per RSI regime; no re-entry
method.candidate: Same initial entry plus re-entry after close is at least 0.75% below the highest close in the active RSI regime; maximum 6 entries per zone; 26h cooldown after exit
method.stops: 1.25% close-triggered alpha stop queued for next 1h open; 2.5% catastrophe stop checked against every 1m low; max hold 24h
method.costs: Commission on actual entry and exit notionals; 2bp slippage each side; funding at actual event timestamps using the containing minute's mark-price open approximation
method.drawdown: Minute-by-minute adverse low mark-to-market, plus realized equity

chronological_split: 50% train / 20% validation / 30% OOS by complete hourly bars; no parameter tuning
limitations: Funding event mark uses minute-open approximation, not exact event mark.
One BTC symbol only; does not prove cross-asset robustness.
Historical fills are simulated at next-hour open; no order-book queue model.
A stop gap is filled at the worse of the stop and minute open, plus slippage; still a bar-based approximation.
